name: tool-stt
description: Transcribe audio files in the workspace: stt.transcribe sends the clip to a speech model and returns text

settings.title: STT
settings.description: stt.transcribe reads an audio or video file in the project and returns the spoken text. The route is models.routes.stt on an openai-compat server that accepts POST /audio/transcriptions.

fields.label: Model / route
fields.help: Empty = models.routes.stt. Override with a models.routes key or provider/model-id (openai-compat speech-to-text, for example openai/whisper-1).

fields.label: Max audio size
fields.help: OpenAI-compatible transcription accepts one file up to 25 MB.

fields.label: Language
fields.help: ISO-639-1, for example ru. Empty lets the model detect the language. A call can still pass its own language.
